CHOLERA_MGMT_001.description: Plan C is applicable only when severe dehydration or shock is present.

CHOLERA_MGMT_002.description: Plan B is applicable to some dehydration and must not be used when severe dehydration is present.

CHOLERA_MGMT_003.description: Plan A is applicable only when there are no signs of dehydration.

CHOLERA_ABX_001.description: Antibiotics are applicable when the patient has severe dehydration, is pregnant, or is elderly.
